forum.title: SensorTile.Box PRO support confirmation in MEMS Studio
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Calufe ,

The SensorTile.Box PRO is shipped with a default firmware that is compatible with the ST BLE Sensor app.

If you want to use it with MEMS Studio, the board must be programmed with the dedicated MEMS Studio datalog firmware, either:

* through AlgoBuilder, or

* using the dedicated Datalog Extended firmware, available in both Serial and BLE versions and released together with MEMS Studio.

You can find all the related setup and programming steps in the “Programming the target” section (page 118/134) and “Firmware programming” section (page 124/134) of the [MEMS Studio User Manual](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um3233-getting-started-with-memsstudio-stmicroelectronics.pdf).
forum.content_text:
Hi ST Team,

I understand that the SensorTile.Box PRO is supported by MEMS Studio, can you please confirm?

Currently the device/kit is not recognized by MEMS studio but the ST BLE App only.

Thanks!
forum.author: Calufe
